name: What types of window screen materials are available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of window screen materials are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When replacing window screens, common materials include fiberglass, aluminum, and pet-resistant screens. Fiberglass is a popular choice due to its durability, affordability, and flexibility, resisting dents and creases. Aluminum screens offer greater strength and a clearer view but can be more prone to dents. Pet-resistant screens are typically made from a heavy-duty vinyl-coated polyester, designed to withstand scratching and tearing from pets. Specialty screens for sun protection or improved airflow are also available, offering solutions for specific needs like energy efficiency or enhanced ventilation.
